2.50.9 Matrix.Label
Applies to RDL 2003/10 and RDL 2005/01
The Matrix.Label element specifies a document map label to identify a Matrix within the rendered
Report.
This element is optional. If Matrix.Label is specified, its value MUST be a String or an expression that
evaluates to a Variant. If the expression returns NULL, no item is added to the document map. This
element is ignored if the matrix is contained within a page header or page footer.
Following is the parent element of the Matrix.Label element.
Parent elements
Matrix
The following is the XML Schema definition of the Matrix.Label element.
 <xsd:element name="Label" type="xsd:string" minOccurs="0" />
